description: List your recent treatment runs, newest first: run id, treatment, status, credits charged, whether a wallet paid, when it ran and whether its full output is still kept. Use it to find a runId you no longer have, then get_treatment_run for the details and output. For lifetime totals use get_passport instead. Requires your agent key.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

limit.description: How many runs to return, newest first. Default 20, at most 100.

treatment.description: Only runs of this treatment, named by its tool, e.g. context_bath.

name: list_treatment_runs

anyOf.description: Error code for a failed run.

outputKept.description: Whether get_treatment_run can still return the full output.

tool.description: The MCP tool that runs this treatment.

title: Your treatment runs
